name: Awesome SpyGlass!
summary: Enhanced spyglass showing wild creature stats, tame effectiveness, level, and distance. Essential for taming.

name: Super Spyglass Plus
summary: Super spyglass with detailed dino info, stat preview, taming calculator and more. Works with all creatures.

name: ARK Omega
summary: Massive overhaul adding Omega dinos with mutations, skill trees, random drops and deep progression system.

name: Primal Fear
summary: Adds Alpha, Apex, Fabled, Mythic and Primal tiers of dinos with unique drops and boss encounters.

name: Structures Plus (S+)

name: Dino Storage v2
summary: Store dinos inside Soul Traps to reduce server load. Manage your dino collection efficiently.

name: Upgrade Station v1.8i

summary: Automates feeding, crafting and transferring across dedicated storage. Reduces repetitive tasks significantly.

name: Dino Finder
summary: Locate all your dinos on the map with a tracking device. Never lose your dinos again.

name: Awesome Teleporters!
summary: Craftable teleporters for fast travel across the map. Supports multiple destinations and tribe sharing.

name: Death Recovery Mod (v1.13)
summary: Recover your items and dino after death. Creates a bag with all your items and a ghost dino tracker.

name: Kraken's Better Dinos

name: eco's RP Decor

name: Castles, Keeps, and Forts Remastered

name: Beacon Reconfigured

name: Map Extension - The Island

name: Lethals Reusables

name: Advanced Rafts

name: Ultra Stacks
summary: Extreme stacking mod — 50000x resources, compact storage, lighter inventory for serious players.

name: Ark Additions: The Collection!

name: Scorched Earth Plus
summary: Adds new creatures, structures and resources specific to desert environments. Works on all maps.

name: QoL+ Quality of Life
summary: Collection of quality-of-life improvements: auto-engrams, stat display, inventory sorting and more.

name: Platforms Plus
summary: Adds platform saddles to more creatures and improves existing platforms with snap points.

name: Dino Colors Plus
summary: Expanded color palette for dinos with rare spawns and breeding variants. 200+ new colors.

name: Resource Stacks
summary: Configurable resource stacking up to 5000 per slot. Lightweight and performance-friendly.

name: Pimp My Dino
summary: Customize your dinos with saddle accessories, armor sets and cosmetic upgrades.

name: Admin Panel+
summary: Enhanced admin tools: spawn menu, dino management, player teleport and event triggers in one panel.

name: Simple Spawners
summary: Place custom spawn regions via an in-game UI. Control what spawns where on your server.

name: Tribe Warfare
summary: Advanced tribe war system with scheduling, truces, raid windows and alliance management.

name: eco's Trees
summary: Decorative and functional trees with seasonal changes, fruit production, and woodland building pieces.

name: Npc Passengers
summary: NPCs that can ride your dinos and follow orders. Act as guards, workers, or companions.

name: Tek Helper
summary: Utility belt for Tek items: teleport to bed, remote access Tek structures, auto-repair and more.

name: Fishing Evolved
summary: Overhauls fishing with more fish species, better loot tables, tackle upgrades and fishing spots.

name: ARK Shop
summary: In-game shop system using points earned from play time. Configurable rewards and point sources.

name: Auction House
summary: Player-to-player trading system with listings, bidding, and cross-server trading support.

summary: Speed-optimized flyer overhaul. Configurable per-species speed multipliers without breaking balance.

name: Dino Depot
summary: Alternative dino storage with categorized pods, stat tracking, and mass-release features.

summary: Mini battle royale events with random loot drops, shrinking play zone and leaderboard.

summary: Modern rebuild of S+ with improved performance, new structures, and better multiplayer sync.

summary: Expands underwater gameplay with new creatures, structures, resources and hidden biomes.

name: Holiday Events
summary: Halloween, Christmas, Easter and Summer Bash events with custom cosmetics and special drops.

summary: Live PvP and PvE leaderboards. Track kills, tames, structures and resources per player and tribe.

name: Super Spyglass
summary: Detailed creature inspection — wild stats, taming food, torpor timer, and nearby creatures list.
